Clustering of cells using t–distributed stochastic neighbor embedding ( tSNE ) revealed a separation of STMN2 expressing neurons, from progenitors and mitotically active cells expressing VIM and TOP2A ( Extended Data Fig. 3c ).

Clustering of cells using t–distributed stochastic neighbor embedding ( tSNE ) revealed a separation of STMN2 expressing neurons, from progenitors and mitotically active cells expressing VIM and TOP2A ( Extended Data Fig. 3c ).

We also identified a group of glutamatergic neurons ( VGLUT1 + ) expressing the cortical layer markers TBR1 ; a group of intermediate progenitors expressing EOMES ; a group of dorsal progenitors expressing PAX6 ; a group of astroglia ( CLU + ); a small group of cells that resemble the choroid plexus ( TTR + , SLC13A4 + ) and a very small number of GAD1 + cells.
